cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll give your promotion toast. Wonderful timing with the director's retirement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll mention your hard work. How lovely that the vacancy waited for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A short toast, then: 'To your success. May the rest of us live long enough for another vacancy.'

reason: A takes the toast and shortens it to retain B cooperation while the warm success wish reveals growing resentment about A own prospects.
